description: The caller's own balances (prepaid credit for Rokha's models; formerly fuel tanks): deposit wallet, spendable balance (USD, and $ROKHA when it funded it), owner-funded vs donated, burned and housed totals, burn tier, and whether the balance is dormant (below one turn's reserve). Every balance is spend-only — nothing is withdrawable. On an agent's own turn it shows only that agent's balance. Read-only; signed-in callers only.

wallet_address.description: The caller's owner identity (injected from context).
